added.t: The U.S. has recently enacted and proposed to enact significant new tariffs and trade restrictions.
There continues to exist significant uncertainty about the future relationship between the U.S. and other countries with respect to trade policies, trade agreements, trade restrictions and tariffs.

To date, the FERC has issued orders under Section 3 of the NGA authorizing the siting, construction and operation of all of our Trains in operation or under construction, as well as orders under Section 7 of the NGA authorizing the construction and operation …

Additionally, we have ad valorem legacy property tax incentives secured for the Corpus Christi LNG Terminal, inclusive of the Corpus Christi Stage 3 Project and the CCL Midscale Trains 8 & 9 Project, and the Sabine Pass LNG Terminal that begin to expire …

removed.t: We became subject to the 15% CAMT in 2024.
